subject: 🏃 Friday — Stability & Power (Wk 1)
html:
Tomorrow: Stability & Power — Cañada College

Second gym session of Week 1. This one is all single-leg work, isometrics, and the PT-prescribed core block — no bilateral compounds, no heavy bar. The goal is knee-tracking stability and tendon resilience, not max load.

Dynamic warm-up: Foam roll quads/IT band (1 min each) → 90/90 PAILs (30 sec each position) → banded lateral walks (10 each direction) → Spanish squat hold (30 sec) → Copenhagen plank (20 sec each side).

Session:

  • Bulgarian split squat — 15 lb/hand, 3×8–10 each side (3-sec eccentric, hips square)
  • Single-leg RDL (DB contralateral) — 15 lb/hand, 3×8–10 each side (3-sec eccentric, hinge don't bend)
  • Spanish squat hold — light band, 3×30–45 sec (vertical shin, deep bend)
  • Copenhagen plank — BW, 3×20–30 sec each side
  • Side plank w/ hip abduction (PT) — BW, 8 reps each side, top toe pointing to floor
  • Dead bug w/ banded pulldown (PT) — light band, 2–3×10 slow marches
  • Chin tuck + lifts (PT) — 2 reps each direction (front, diag L, diag R), 3-sec hold

Focus cue: Watch your right knee tracking on the Bulgarian splits. The PT flagged hip internal rotation and weak external rotators — if that knee dives inward under load, slow down, reset, and push the knee out over the pinky toe. Mirror or video one set if you can.

Context: Week 1 of 12, Phase 1 Foundation — 79 days to race day. You're 4 for 4 at knee 1/5 this week: track Tuesday, heavy strength Wednesday, steady base today, all clean. Today's 6-miler came in at 8:54 pace with a 144 avg HR — slightly conservative but exactly the right call between two strength days. Tomorrow's session won't tax the aerobic system, so you'll be fresh for Saturday's travel-shifted 8-mile long run in Victoria.

Prep tonight: Pack your gym bag now — straps if you've got them for the single-leg RDLs, a light band for Spanish squats and the PT exercises. Protein-forward dinner tonight to support recovery from today's run and tomorrow's lift. Bed by 10, up at 5:30.
